## Learning Objectives

In this companion work-along lab for [Study 19](../analyses/19_ordered_tb_exp_decay_statespace.qmd), you will:

1. Compare **Exponential Half-Life Decay** weights ($w(\Delta t) = 2^{-\Delta t/H}$) against a discontinuous flat 30-day boxcar window.
2. Verify **zero monotonicity violations** across all `43,740` locked `2025` batter-games via zero-copy **DuckDB SQL**.
3. Render a **Dark Cyber** diagnostic curve showing why `H* = 30d` smooth decay beats both noisy `7d` half-lives and flat `30d` boxcars on `Over 5.5 K` ROC AUC.

## Mentor Checkpoints

1. **Checkpoint 1 (Decay Weights):** Confirm that $w(30; H=30) = 0.5$ and that smooth decay eliminates the Day-31 boxcar discontinuity.
2. **Checkpoint 2 (Algebraic Monotonicity):** Confirm `0` violations of $P(\text{TB} \ge 1) \ge P(\text{TB} \ge 2) \ge P(\text{TB} \ge 3) \ge P(\text{TB} \ge 4)$ across all `43,740` OOS starts.
3. **Checkpoint 3 (Start-Frequency Signal-to-Noise):** Explain why MLB starters' 5-day rotation cadence makes `H = 7d` overfit 1-start noise while `H* = 30d` over a 90-day lookback maximizes locked `2025` OOS AUC (`0.6827`).
